candidate.publisher: Virginia State Corporation Commission Office of the Clerk
candidate.availability: discretionary structured-data request with reasonable fees; no documented recurring product or public bulk file
candidate.price: Unknown; reasonable database or structured-data fees may be quoted

observed_evidence: The Office of the Clerk is Virginia's central filing office for corporations, partnerships, limited liability companies, and business trusts, and its business-entity records are generally open to examination.

Virginia law and regulation permit the Commission to provide records from a computer database or structured data collection and to charge reasonable fees, but do not publish a recurring business-entity product contract.

An official system procurement document describes a candidate unique SCC-ID and principal-office information, while also contemplating possible reassignment if a new identifier scheme is adopted; it is not a current extract schema.
The public CIS route is an interactive entity search with cookie consent, not a documented bulk API or static file, and must not be enumerated or automated.

The SCC web policy limits commercial use beyond intended public availability and grants only fair use of website contents; requested extract retention, derived-publication, and redistribution rights remain unresolved.

observed_evidence: DFI sells the complete corporate database as a text file for $40 per snapshot through ShareFile, with one-time, weekly Tuesday, and monthly second-Tuesday order options.

The data-services page names only legal name, registered agent and office address, entity type, formation date, current status, and annual-report indicator; it publishes no exact layout, sample, delimiter, encoding, count, bytes, checksum, or manifest.

The seven-character DFI Entity ID is assigned when first organized and public status/type dictionaries exist, but bulk inclusion, non-reuse, conversion, merger, reinstatement, and migration continuity are not guaranteed.
DFI expressly says it is not a registry of all businesses and cannot certify legal operation; the July 2026 active count of 635,017 also excludes miscellaneous entities and foreign registered names.

The only bulk-listed address is registered agent or office data, which is ineligible for entity geocoding; full-snapshot deletion, correction, replay, unattended ShareFile, retention, transformation, geocoding, and redistribution terms are unpublished.
